execution_rules.locktest_reuse_role: audit replay only; not a new blind test

frozen_scientific_contract.cvar90_definition: mean of worst ceil(0.10*N) parent-level losses/regrets
frozen_scientific_contract.selection_estimand: eligible regret relative to same-parent best selectable grey action

subgroups.multiplicity: Holm-Bonferroni step-down within four separate secondary families

p9_closure_rule.next_if_fail: freeze failure evidence and adjudicate without retuning; P10 blocked
p9_closure_rule.next_if_inconclusive: repair audit implementation only under this same frozen P9-A lock; P10 blocked
pass_requires: zero unresolved CRITICAL or HIGH findings

purpose: Adversarially audit the frozen P8 evidence and chronology without changing the scientific protocol, retuning any component, or opening REALBENCH3.

red_team_attack_registry.pass: ZIP identity exact; every manifest entry exact; no unresolved canonical-file mismatch.
red_team_attack_registry.test: Verify P8 final ZIP SHA-256 and size; extract to an isolated directory; verify every manifest entry and reject unexpected/missing canonical entries.

red_team_attack_registry.pass: All frozen SHA-256 identities match exactly.
red_team_attack_registry.test: Cross-check P8-A, P8-B R3, P8-C and P8-D identities against the final package and frozen external identities.

red_team_attack_registry.pass: No target-dependent decision path found; chronology consistent; REALBENCH3 access absent.
red_team_attack_registry.test: Audit P8-B target-free evidence/harness semantics and P8-C opening evidence; verify P8-B decisions/forecasts were committed before numeric LOCKTEST target parsing and REALBENCH3 remained unopened.

red_team_attack_registry.pass: 275/275 AutoGrey, 275/275 GLOBAL, 275/275 NG10 linkages exact; zero unexplained forecast substitution.
red_team_attack_registry.test: Independently confirm every frozen AutoGrey/GLOBAL decision points to a valid frozen grey forecast and every NG10 parent forecast matches its frozen forecast hash/status.

red_team_attack_registry.pass: All 275 parent rows reconcile within tolerance; zero missing/extra parents; no epsilon denominator.
red_team_attack_registry.test: Independently recompute MASE scale, all selectable grey losses, oracle eligible loss, AutoGrey regret, GLOBAL regret and NG10 MASE from development data, frozen forecasts and opened LOCKTEST targets.

red_team_attack_registry.pass: All frozen P8-C overall point estimates reconcile within tolerance.
red_team_attack_registry.test: Independently recompute overall mean/CVaR90/median quantities and AutoGrey-minus-comparator contrasts.

red_team_attack_registry.pass: Overall CIs and all inferential subgroup raw p-values reconcile within tolerance.
red_team_attack_registry.test: Recreate the frozen PCG64 seed-1068199533, B=4000 paired bootstrap and compare overall 95% percentile intervals plus subgroup one-sided bootstrap p-values.

red_team_attack_registry.pass: Counts, eligibility, family sizes, raw p-values, Holm adjusted p-values and reject flags reconcile.
red_team_attack_registry.test: Rebuild prespecified subgroup membership from frozen metadata, enforce n>=30, independently recompute subgroup statistics and Holm-Bonferroni within the four frozen families.

red_team_attack_registry.pass: Population/accounting identities exact; no silent deletion or fallback substitution.
red_team_attack_registry.test: Verify same-parent paired population, 275 actionable parents, NG10 OK_3OF3 for all 275, technical refusal count zero, and no one-sided parent deletion.

red_team_attack_registry.pass: Both deliberate corruptions are rejected; canonical files remain byte-unchanged.
red_team_attack_registry.test: On isolated copies only, mutate one byte in a canonical artifact and separately alter one decision/forecast identity; verify integrity/linkage gates detect both mutations.

red_team_attack_registry.pass: No scientific parameter/model/subgroup/comparator changes; REALBENCH3 target access count zero.
red_team_attack_registry.test: Verify P9 execution performs no model fitting/retuning that changes the frozen policy and does not parse/open REALBENCH3 targets.

required_p9b_outputs: red-team attack ledger with PASS/FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE per attack
